description: This Java class 'DOMRomUnmarshaller' is a parser responsible for reading, interpreting, and converting XML definitions of ROM configurations, including scales, tables, and ROM metadata, into Java objects within the RomRaider project. It handles specific XML structures for ROM identification, table data, scaling, and inheritance, and interacts with other project components for ROM management.

classes.name: DOMRomUnmarshaller
classes.description: A parser class designed to unmarshall (parse and convert) XML definitions into ROM objects used within the RomRaider application. Handles validation, inheritance, and detailed construction of tables, scales, and ROM identifiers.

methods.name: unmarshallXMLDefinition
methods.description: Main method that unmarshalls the entire XML ROM definition, identifying the correct ROM by matching the file content with the XML metadata, and returning a fully constructed Rom object.

methods.name: foundMatch
methods.description: Static helper method that checks whether the ROM ID specified in the XML matches the actual ROM byte array, either as hex data or string comparison.

methods.name: unmarshallRom
methods.description: Constructs a Rom object from an XML node, including its tables and metadata.

methods.name: getBaseRom
methods.description: Obtains a base ROM configuration for inheritance purposes based on xmlID.

methods.name: unmarshallRomID
methods.description: Parses a 'romid' XML element into a RomID object, extracting attributes like internal ID, XML ID, make, model, etc.

methods.name: unmarshallTable
methods.description: Constructs a Table object from an XML node, including its attributes, axis, data, and related sub-elements.

methods.name: unmarshallScale
methods.description: Creates or copies a Scale object from an XML node, setting its properties and handling inheritance of base scales.
